source: Market research (2025-2026 postings + posting-share reports) - CLUSTER-QUAL-001 stage 4 (spec 7.6), weekly refresh
method: Nine cluster passes run inline on the desktop (Gabo-PC): built-in WebSearch/WebFetch plus the relay site-scoped search (GET /api/cse-search, CSE_PROXY_TOKEN 64-hex, Brave backend; first run where that machine-token route answered 200 from the desktop). Each pass given the shipped 2026-10-04 top-20 as baseline, constrained to evidence-backed keep/reorder/merge/add/drop. Ranking evidence is posting share only; skills-gap surveys and editorial lists are context, not rank input. Jobindex site-scoped hits (9 queries, dateRestrict=m1) give Danish ROLE evidence only (hosted pages are teaser-only, see the 2026-10-04 method note), so no Danish requirement-level share was available this run. INTERVAL: 11 days after 2026-10-04 (the scheduled Fri 2026-10-09 run deferred to 2026-10-15 by the desktop-app-local trigger). SECOND PASS (cloud weekly routine): SeekerScore role pages (shares of active postings in a 625,168-posting corpus, updated 2026-10-12; market-wide skills are filtered out, so a move is made only between items present in, or clearly absent from, the same role list): data analyst n=55,107, HR/recruiting n=16,082, financial analyst n=76,403, product manager n=15,981, hardware engineering n=5,109. Financial analyst and product manager pages showed no inversion large enough to move finance or pm_process; hardware engineering is electronics-led and gives no photonics rank input. Plus Kickresume (cross-industry only).
note: 4 of 9 clusters changed, 5 re-confirmed unchanged. No adds or drops. pm_process: wording broadening only, r4 now names budget & cost control (Huntr 23,229 PM postings: budget management 13.5%, 2,729 required vs 316 preferred; Seeker 2,177: budgeting 7.3%), ranks untouched. finance: professional qualification (CPA/ACCA/CFA/CIMA/MBA) promoted 17->11, bounded to 6 places (AuditFriendly 2,230 live FP&A postings: CPA 20.3% + CFA 7.7%, third-most-named token behind Excel 49.7% and Power BI 21.2%, ahead of SAP 13.1%, SQL 10%, GAAP 6.7%); items r11-r16 shift down one. Theme: new posting-share datasets confirm the tool/credential layer; AI items hold their ranks because the new PM datasets do not tally AI at all and the product-manager evidence (Qarera, AI 37.0%) still stands. SECOND PASS (cloud weekly routine, same date): people_soft performance management 13->9 and total rewards 15->14; data_analytics data governance 19->16. Reorders only, each on a share gap of at least 2x in one SeekerScore posting set (updated 2026-10-12). Kickresume (1.4M US/UK postings, Mar-Aug 2026) confirms management at 44% overall (72% finance, 54% technology) and explicit AI-tool mentions at 0.2%, but has no per-cluster ranks, so no AI item moved.

data_analytics.label: Data & Analytics
data_analytics.changes_summary: Data governance, privacy & ethics 19->16; experiment design & A/B testing 16->17, domain knowledge 17->18, Git 18->19 (second 2026-10-15 pass, cloud routine). SeekerScore data analyst postings (n=55,107 active, updated 2026-10-12) name data governance in 9.0%; neither A/B testing nor Git is among its 30 role-defining skills (floor 1.1%; product analytics 1.6%). Data engineering 14.1% and ETL 10.5% back r8/r12 as placed; Tableau 12.9% / Power BI 12.2% / BI 10.2% back r3. First pass (desktop): Re-confirmed unchanged. Huntr (25,152 analyst postings, Q1 2026): data analysis 34.3%, SQL 33.5%, communication 31.1%, analytical 26.6%, Python 21.9% (2,254 required / 2,238 preferred), problem-solving 19.7%, data visualisation 17.6%, Excel 15.8%, Tableau 14.1%, project management 13.9%, Power BI 12.6%. This dataset puts Python above visualisation (21.9% vs 17.6%, though Tableau+Power BI overlap to 26.7%) while Qarera and AccioJob put BI above Python, so the 10-04 r3 BI / r4 Python order stays: 2 of 4 datasets each way is not evidence for a move. Excel r2 vs Huntr 15.8%: sources still disagree on the SQL/Excel pair, no move. Communication 31.1% supports r11 storytelling staying in the top half.
